text: Rajeev Viswanathan, Board Member, Greater Toronto Airports Authority Board of Directors and Michael Mendel, Manager, Government Affairs and Stakeholder Relations, Greater Toronto Airports Authority, will give a presentation on Annual Greater Toronto Airports Authority (GTAA) Update, including activities and recovery from the COVID-19 pandemic.

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Received the presentation from Rajeev Viswanathan, Board Member, Greater Toronto Airports Authority Board of Directors and Michael Mendel, Manager, Government Affairs and Stakeholder Relations, Greater Toronto Airports Authority, headed "2021 GTAA Annual Update City of Toronto", for information.
